items.contentSnippet:
Hi HN, we built Compartment with a simple idea in mind: deployment should be as simple as possible.
Just write this to Claude or Codex: “Deploy this app to up.compartment.dev.”
Your agent authorizes itself, inspects any existing deployment files or generates the necessary configuration, builds and deploys your app, then gives you a URL.
